comparedScanforgeFit.provenance: Fresh shared fitter on hash-pinned connected STL; matching serialized control counts, not native UI labels or algorithm identity

nativeProjectedResidual.scope: Projected Z residual at source XY, not closest-point/native UI RMS

scanforgeProjectedResidual.scope: Projected Z residual at source XY, not closest-point/native UI RMS

commonDomain.scope: Intersection of control-net XY bounds, with projected inverse residual checked at every sample; includes extrapolation outside the scanned region

scanforgeKernelThickeningOfNativeSurface.scope: ScanForge kernel on actual native fit; not a native QuickSurface thicken result

capturedNativeSolid.scope: Actual native Thicken default Depth1=0.1mm, middle one-sided icon; compare both signed ScanForge directions rather than infer the icon's normal convention

integrationDiagnostics.scope: Diagnostic only; full-body adaptive integrals and translation sensitivity, not native equivalence or an accepted tolerance change
integrationDiagnostics.samplingScope: D1 on a 3x3 interior grid of adaptor UV bounds; samples are not classified against face trims

scannedTriangleCentroids.scope: 200 source-triangle XY centroids; reported alongside the full rectangular domain, not substituted for it

trimmedFaceDistanceProbe.scope: Bidirectional sampled point-to-trimmed-face distances on one paired sidewall; not Hausdorff distance, global spatial equivalence or a tolerance change
trimmedFaceDistanceProbe.queryAlgorithm: Existing BRepExtrema_DistShapeShape_1 vertex-to-face path with kernel default settings; no sampled UV correspondence assumed
